compatibility.server: Vercel Node22.x; ai7 requires Node>=22; root package already pins22.x
compatibility.version_mix_policy: Pin exact researched versions together and verify lockfile; do not mix AI5/6 stepCountIs/result-helper recipes with AI7 without type/API review.

api_contract.function_signature: export default { async fetch(request: Request): Promise<Response> { ... } }
api_contract.alternative_signature: export async function POST(request: Request): Promise<Response> { ... }
api_contract.server_location: Repository root api/ independent of apps/site/dist; dependencies belong in the function owner/root workspace package
api_contract.client: useChat from @ai-sdk/react with stable DefaultChatTransport from ai; explicit api, no production DirectChatTransport agent/key in browser
api_contract.agent: ToolLoopAgent from ai; stopWhen:isStepCount(policy.maxSteps), maxRetries:0; default20steps is not a budget
deprecated_avoid: older stepCountIs imports assumed valid in AI7
api_contract.transport_protocol: AI SDK UI message SSE protocol; raw text/JSON from the existing visitor gateway is not interchangeable
api_contract.existing_api_rewrite: Root SPA rewrite excludes/api and/.well-known; Vite local /api proxy currently points toPython3003 and needs an explicit agent-runtime dev route.

provider_contract.request_wins_risk: Adapter chat doStream spreads providerOptions.openrouter after generated body; model/messages/provider can be overridden unless application refuses all client overrides. Model/factory extraBody can also override generated values.
provider_contract.usage_cost_source: providerMetadata.openrouter.usage.cost when actually delivered; normalized token usage alone is not currency cost
provider_contract.missing_cost_policy: reserved/unresolved pending provider reconciliation; never infer zero or retry automatically
provider_contract.stream_retries: streamText streamRetries:number default0; maxRetries default2 must explicitly become0. Do not pass options to unsupported ToolLoopAgent fields.

authorization.public_visitor: Explicitly bounded public-service capability only; production server-owned visitor cookie/session store, CSRF+Origin, ownership and quotas required; not a tenant membership
authorization.private_web: Separate Clerk session/JWT verification for owned web API plus trusted tenant/site/role mapping; frontend login is not authorisation
authorization.mcp: Separate OAuth access-token verifier accepts oauth_token and exact MCP resource audience; website session tokens are not MCP access tokens
authorization.supplied_invalid_credentials: 401 before provider; never downgrade to guest
authorization.tenant: Derive actor/site/tenant and allowed tool set server-side; ignore caller role, balance, tenant and account claims
authorization.message_input: Bound schema/size/count. Initial public endpoint accepts bounded text only; no client system instructions, provider overrides, tool approvals/results, mediaURL fetch or forged assistant state. Reconstruct owned history server-side.
authorization.byok: Future authenticated secure upload/reference only, encrypted server vault and server-only decrypt at authorised dispatch; no localStorage/sessionStorage/querystring/model message/build ENV/browser provider key. No BYOK live adapter claimed.

cost_and_state.missing_provider_or_budget_policy: Fail closed before provider construction/dispatch; UI reports unavailable, not generated response
cost_and_state.test_mode: Injected MockLanguageModelV4 or fake fetch only, visibly labelled test/demo; never automatic fallback for a failed paid call
required_preflight: fresh unique catalog capability and complete fee validation
valid user/visitor capability and idempotency payload binding
server budget/credit approval; no implicit NeX2fly free inference
cost_and_state.durable_store: Required server-side managed database/transactional store; no Vercel process memory,/tmp or local visitorSQLite as production source of truth
cost_and_state.idempotency_scope: server owner+site/service context+operation+request key+payload hash; replay must not dispatch a second paid call
cost_and_state.disconnect: Client abort is not proof of no charge; retain request/provider id and reserve until reconciled. Explicit stream resume requires ownership and durable existing stream, not another model request.
cost_and_state.tools: Initially none or narrow read-only public catalog tool; every later side effect separately schema/auth/rule/idempotency gated by actual backend state
cost_and_state.billing: No provider prices, free tier, throughput or hard financial guarantees inferred from SDK; no provider response cost delivered means no zero-cost settlement

test_plan.method: Instantiate AI7 MockLanguageModelV4 with deterministic doStream and UIstream response; feed actual DefaultChatTransport/useChat; verify parts, completion,error,abort.

Real ToolLoopAgent with MockLanguageModelV4 sequence tool-call then text; execute harmless bounded local read-only tool exactly once, assert step limit and no business effects. V4 tool input is JSON string and finishReason is object.

Real OpenRouter3 SDK with explicit fake fetch and dummy key; inspect actual JSONmodel/reasoning/routing/tokenlimit; reject override attempts before dispatch. Fake usage/cost are fixtures, not actual charges.
No credentials, invalid auth/CSRF/origin, wrongowner, badschema, missingbudget,costoverflow,unsupportedcatalog => provider dispatch count0.
Concurrent idempotent replay, forged conversation and tool result, DBfailure, disconnect/ambiguous outcome; no double dispatch or false success, durable unresolved receipt.

Vercel local/build packaging smoke with Node22: root/api retained with Vite dist, POST/SSE contract, bundle contains no secrets, private/auth routes still failclosed; actual deployment acceptance separate.

implementation_sequence: Root owner alone pins root/server ai+provider+zod and apps/site client dependency, updates lock once; no parallel installs.
Implement platform-neutral Request->Response handler with injected auth/store/budget/model dependencies and default disabled policy.
Wire root/api/agent-chat.ts and explicit local dev target, retain existing visitor action routes without impersonating a model.
Run real SDK mock/tool/HTTP-wire and durable negative/concurrency tests before any live provider call.
Add native streaming UI states and accurate connection/mode disclosure; never execute arbitrary model text.
Only bind actual model after account/provider/privacy/budget prerequisites are concretely approved and available; no paidcall performed by this research.
